info.name: Native Wiki
info.summary: Turn your Markdown files into a powerful wiki inside Nextcloud
info.description:
Turn your Markdown files into an organized and easy-to-navigate wiki directly inside Nextcloud.
## Features
- **Folder-based navigation** — Browse your wiki through a familiar folder tree. - **Built-in Markdown editor** — Read, edit and preview Markdown without leaving Nextcloud. - **Full-text search** — Quickly find content across your Markdown files. - **Breadcrumb navigation** — Always know where you are in your wiki. - **Automatic table of contents** — Navigate headings within long documents. - **Internal Markdown links** — Follow relative links between pages while staying inside Native Wiki. - **Mermaid diagrams** — Render flowcharts, sequence diagrams and other Mermaid diagrams directly in your pages. - **Syntax highlighting** — Display code blocks with language-aware highlighting. - **File management** — Create, rename, move and delete files and folders directly from the wiki. - **Drag and drop** — Organize files and folders using drag-and-drop. - **Markdown and All Files views** — Focus on Markdown or browse all files in your Wiki Root. - **Light and dark themes** — Integrates with your Nextcloud theme.
## Your files, your wiki
Native Wiki works directly with standard `.md` files stored in Nextcloud. Your content remains portable and accessible without being locked into a proprietary format.
Choose a folder as your **Wiki Root** and Native Wiki turns its contents into your personal wiki while keeping the underlying files fully accessible through Nextcloud Files.
info.author: Diego Romero
